scheme_name: Sanction of Enhancement of Marriage Incentive Awards for Marriages Between Persons with Differently Abled and Normal Persons
other_conditions: The marriage must be between a differently abled person and a normal person
The couple must not have previously availed the incentive under this scheme
Both bridegroom and bride must be present at the time of verification with original certificates
benefits_summary: Marriage incentive award of ₹1,00,000 (previously ₹50,000) for eligible couples
